description: A closed black hard case sits on the table in front of you, with small items inside once it’s opened. The left hand moves in to the front latch while the right hand comes down onto the lid; the left hand releases the latch and the right hand lifts the lid open, then the right hand reaches into the case, pulls out a gray eyeglass-style case and sets it on the table, and next removes a small white duck-shaped object and places it beside the gray case while the left hand hovers near the front edge.
